messages:
tara: Quick postmortem follow-up — the delayed metering incident last week. We need clear owners, ETAs for the backfill, and the customer credit/appeals plan. cc @aj @mike

aj: On it. I have a preliminary diff for the ingest window fix and a backfill plan. I'll run a dry-run tomorrow on the replica and post results.

mike: I can own customer comms and the credit calc. What exact query should we use so finance/support and engineering are aligned?

terra: (note: fixing typo) tara: Use the canonical table `billing.token_ledger_v2` with an `event_time` filter. aj — share the exact query + the replica run output so we all use the same numbers.

aj: Pasting the quick query snippet I'll run:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing.token_ledger_v2
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-10' AND event_time < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
I'll attach the dry-run CSV as a GH gist when done. Running on replica (read-only) to avoid affecting prod.

jun: I'll own reconciliation and produce a CSV of affected customers with suggested credit amounts (rule: credit = max(0, billed_tokens - reconciled_tokens) * unit_rate). Target: EOD Friday for initial list.

tara: Proposed owners & timeline: aj = backfill & hotfix (PR #1423), jun = reconciliation script + CSV, mike = customer credits & comms. Timeline: dry-run Thu AM, apply backfill Mon AM, credits issued Tue. Feels tight but doable — any objections?

aj: Dry-run Thu morning works. If dry-run looks clean I'll have a PR for staging Thu evening. Need ops approval for the Mon AM production run. Also found an edge case where resends from aggregator may double-count borderline events — I'll add an idempotency guard as part of the hotfix.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule maintenance window for Mon 03/16 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please confirm in #eng-oncall so the ops team can approve.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer email and support reply template. Jun — please include the affected account list + suggested credit amounts in the CSV (columns: customer_id, billed_tokens, reconciled_tokens, tokens_delta, suggested_credit_usd).

jun: Will do. Also adding a reconciliation flag column for any customer where delta / billed_tokens > 0.01 (1%) so we prioritize manual review. ETA: EOD Fri for CSV.

tara: Also we need a recurring detection & alert: weekly job to flag ingestion lag > 1 hour AND token delta > 0.5%. Jun — can you add an alert to ops-sre and a quick runbook with steps?

jun: Yep — I'll open an alerting PR referencing incident #489 and add runbook steps (how to run the query, how to kick a dry-backfill, contact list). ETA: Fri.

aj: One more note: I'll include automated unit/integration tests for the idempotency guard so we don't regress when we change the aggregator.

mike: For customer messaging draft: "We detected a metering delay that affected usage reporting between Mar 10 and Mar 16. We've corrected your invoice and applied credits where applicable. If you have questions, reply here and we'll escalate." I'll refine once I have the CSV.

tara: :white_check_mark: Great. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, PR links, and the timeline. Setting weekly check-ins until all credits processed and the alert has been running for 2 cycles. Thanks everyone.
